snippet.title: Mine or Burn - Official Announcement Tailer
snippet.description:
Mine asteroids, automate resource collection, and grow your mining operation in this active incremental roguelike built around constant progression. Fuel hyperjumps, invest in permanent upgrades, and push deeper through branching star systems while enemy forces grow stronger.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4308550/Mine_or_Burn/

---
Website: https://www.mineorburn.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/heavypepper
